title: It's Only Calm On The Surface
speaker: Figuring Out Money host (name not stated)

macro_themes.view: S&P at highs with VIX ~15 while bond volatility (MOVE) and high-yield bonds are stressed: a divergence.
49 sessions without a 1% S&P down day; similar streaks preceded the Aug 2024 unwind and COVID crash, so a 1%+ down day soon is likely.
Following the 2018 analog, yields consolidate and pull back, and did not truly come off until after the midterms.
Auctions drove today's reversal; more auctions tomorrow.
